result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual/content problems: a nonsensical '–0%' discount badge, a truncated restaurant name without ellipsis, and a partially rendered filter chip at the screen edge that shows no label.

issues.description: The pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a '–0%' discount badge, which is meaningless — a 0% discount should not be advertised and looks like a data/rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or fix the data source so the correct discount percentage is shown.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making the truncation look accidental rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis (or equivalent truncation styling) to card titles, or ensure the card is clearly peeking as part of a scrollable carousel.

issues.description: The rightmost category filter chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the screen edge and shows no visible text, appearing as an empty pill.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so partially visible chips still show some of their label, signaling horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar without any fade or padding, which can look broken at this scroll position.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or a subtle fade above the navigation bar so partially visible content is clearly scrollable rather than clipped.
